results.question: What type of input does the DQN in the paper use?
results.answer: The DQN (Deep Q-Network) in the paper uses raw pixels as input. It processes these high-dimensional sensory inputs to estimate future rewards, specifically applying the method to Atari 2600 games without adjusting the architecture or learning algorithm.
results.reference_answer: The DQN operates directly on raw visual input from Atari game screens rather than depending on manually engineered visual features.
